name: collapsible
title: Collapsible
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Collapsible. The trigger is a frameless lettering row: its underline thickens on hover and its brush chevron turns in two steps when open. The content unfolds with a drop-in by steps. No frame of its own, so it sits on the page or inside a case the caller adds. Disabled keeps the label on paper with a dashed underline and a not-allowed cursor. Works with Radix and Base UI.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/collapsible". It wraps your own components/ui/collapsible, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A lettering row that unfolds, its chevron turned to ink.
meta.usage:
import { Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/collapsible"

<Collapsible>
  <CollapsibleTrigger>Chapter notes</CollapsibleTrigger>
  <CollapsibleContent>The rooftop scenes were drawn at night.</CollapsibleContent>
</Collapsible>
